title: Plasma Globe Explosion
description: A vibrant, surreal painting of a plasma globe with bright pink, green, yellow, and blue electrical tendrils bursting outward from a glowing pink core. The globe sits on a black base with paint splatters, set against a swirling abstract background of green, pink, and purple circular patterns with colorful paint splashes.
prompt: surreal painting of a plasma globe with vibrant pink core emitting dynamic tendrils of bright green, yellow, blue and pink electricity bursting outward, transparent glass sphere, black stand with paint splatters, abstract swirling background of green pink and purple circles, colorful paint splashes flying through the air, energetic and psychedelic atmosphere, visible brushstrokes, vibrant color palette
